description: This file defines the NextWord class, which models a candidate next word with usage count and includes a comparator for sorting by usage frequency.

classes.name: NextWord
classes.description: Represents a potential next word with usage count, providing methods to mark usage and retrieve count.

classes.name: NextWord.NextWordComparator
classes.description: Comparator class for sorting NextWord instances based on their usage count.

methods.name: NextWord(CharSequence nextWord)
methods.description: Constructor initializing NextWord with a string and default usage count of 1.

methods.name: NextWord(String nextWord, int usedCount)
methods.description: Constructor initializing NextWord with specified string and usage count.

methods.name: markAsUsed
methods.description: Increments the usage count for this NextWord instance.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two NextWord instances based on their usage counts.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NextWord object.
